name: AICardRecommendationCompare
description: The Recommendation Compare Card presents 2–3 AI-generated options in a scannable column layout. Each option shows a confidence/risk badge, expandable tradeoffs, and key metrics. A "Recommended" badge highlights the highest-confidence option. Operators choose, merge, or send to another agent.
intent: Side-by-side comparison of 2–3 AI-generated options with confidence scores, risk levels, expandable tradeoffs, and operator choice controls.
